'''Acrana''', officially the '''Republic of Acrana''', is a country in Acrola, spanning the [[Samarran Mountains|Samarran Mountain range]] of [[Ayuma]]. It is bordered by [[Praesyu]] to the north, [[Ealdorii]] to the east, [[Zenashan]] to the south and the [[Vihsanna Ocean]] and [[Nasuanian Sea]] to the west. [[Samaru]] is the capital, largest city and financial centre.

The [[Samarran Mountains|Samarran Mountain]] have been home to the [[Ouran culture|Ouran]] [[Vasconian culture|Vasconian]] and [[Nasucisan culture|Nasucisan]] peoples. By at least 1500 BFA, an archaic form of [[Nasucisan Languages|Nasucisan]], an [[Alzurian-Ayuman]] language, had diffused into the [[Samarran Mountains|Samarran highlands]]. The first [[Acranan state]] was established in 290 BFA, and through the 2nd century BFA to the 5th century AFA, changed control over 12 times between the [[Vestorian Empire]] and [[Ealdorii Empire]]. It was replaced by the [[Waiyaa of Acrana]]. The Waiyaa of Acrana reached its height under [[Gao the Great]] in the 9st century AFA and in 803 became the first state in the world to adopt _____ as its official religion. Acrana still recognises the Acranan ____ _____, the world's oldest national _____ _____, as the country's primary religious establishment. Under the [[Oatni dynasty]], the [[Oatni Kingdom of Acrana]] was restored in the 10th century, starting the [[Hundred Kingdom period|Hundred Kingdom period]], before falling in 1080. [[Caiiaq Caha]], an Acranan principality and later a kingdom, was located on the coast of the [[Nasuanian Sea]] between the 11th and 14th centuries.

Between the 14th and 16th centuries, the traditional Acranan homeland, composed of [[Northern Acrana]] and [[Southern Acrana]], came under the rule of the alzurian empires of [[Ezhinad Empire|Ezhinad]] and [[Niretuii Empire|Niretuii]], repeatedly ruled by either of the two over the centuries. Throughout the 16th century, Acrana had been rebelling against [[Alzuria (region)]], and after the [[Seniaaii Revolution]], which led to an occupation over nearly two decades, gained independence in the [[treaty of Brimasha]]. During the [[Great Imperial War]], Acrana maintained its neutrality, but was dragged into the subsequent [[Alzurian Civil War]], where up to 1.6 million Acranas were systematically exterminated in the [[Acranan genocide]]. Following the [[Alzurian Revolution]], the Acrana was able to maintain its independence with Southern Auyman support. By 1866, the state was [[annexed]] into the [[Alzurian Union]] as the [[Acranan Republic]]. Today's Republic of Acrana became independent after the [[Red War]], through the [[Treaty of Freedom]]. Acrana led a crackdown on independence movements in its [[Eparia|Eparian Colony]], and international and public pressure on the government to recognise its independence in 1724.

Modern Acrana is a [[wikipedia:Unitary_state|unitary]], multi-party, [[wikipedia:Nation_state democratic|nation-state]]. It is a developing/developed country and r[[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|anks 35th on the Krali Total]] [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|Development Index as of 1764]]. Its economy is primarily based on industrial output and [[wikipedia:Mining|mineral extraction]]. The country is a member of numerous international organisations, including the [[Democratic Action Council|Democratic Action Council.]] 

Acrana supported the once de facto independent [[Republic of Eiuwa]], which had seceded from [[Zenashan]] in 1728, until [[Zenashan]] [[reincorporated]] the region through a siege and [[military offensive in 1760]].
